sourceOccurrences.label: Exact radial block layers
sourceOccurrences.note: VI3Y proves the independent-layer coupling and distinguishes eta_B from the induced full graph and from the full-cluster intersection. Exact power law only.

sourceOccurrences.label: Scale recursion
sourceOccurrences.note: 54V4 supplies the full multinomial gluing proof and rooted identity.

sourceOccurrences.label: Uniform block comparisons and mean error
sourceOccurrences.note: X2A4 proves the fixed-index block comparisons, variance bound and exact mean error. Concentration is conditional on an explicit maximum-to-mean ratio; the critical mean lower bound and hydrodynamic condition are not inferred.

sourceOccurrences.label: Periodic block kernel
sourceOccurrences.note: YY9S defines the finite quotient by the tail subgroup and computes Jper-Jfree=L^(-(d+alpha)n) q/(1-q). It supplies the exact added final coalescent time, without periodic asymptotic claims.

proofUses.reason: Independent child layers give the initial recursion; translation invariance gives the rooted identity.
The layer decomposition and the finite coalescent give independent intermediate bonds, hence moment control and covariance; the finite generator supplies the exact mean equation.
Count fibres of the projection to the first n coordinate blocks, sum the geometric kernel tail, and interpret the added constant intensity as an independent final coalescent interval.
Independent exponential clocks per block and pair give the stated weights by a geometric series; no other wiki assertion is invoked.
